Returned if the Tenable MSSP Platform successfully retrieved the request dashboard widget data.
RESPONSE SCHEMA:
application/json
object
A customer accounts object.
— 404 Returned if the Tenable MSSP Platform could not find the specified dashboard widget.
— 429
Returned if you attempt to send too many requests in a specific period of time. For more information,
see Rate Limiting.
500 Returned if an internal error occurred in the Tenable MSSP Portal.
